items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Do you remember any of the tunes you made with him? ... a lot of blues, that's all I can say... moist blues he plays.

ctx.x: Well I made plenty of records.

Manny. Manny, yeah. Tall, still in the dark fellow. He limped. Something had something wrong with his name. Yeah, Richard Jones. That was his name. Do you remember any of the tunes you made with him? Let me see, a lot of blues, that's all I can say, I can't call them the name but there's a lot of blues, moist blues he plays. What company? What record company? I don't know about it, I don't know if it's Savoy or one of them Savoy or something, I get to Savoy. You're on the right, you find out.
Was that in late years or was that in the 20s?
